resources.title: Fundamentals of Materials Science
resources.access_policy: OpenCourseWare materials; retain MIT OCW licensing and item provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT OpenCourseWare undergraduate materials-science curriculum with lecture notes, problem sets, written assignments and exams.

resources.title: Structure of Materials
resources.access_policy: Free Open Learning Library / OCW course materials; preserve source licensing and provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT materials-structure sequence covering amorphous and crystalline materials, polymers, defects, diffusion and X-ray diffraction, with lecture videos and exams.

resources.title: Materials Processing
resources.access_policy: OpenCourseWare materials; retain MIT OCW licensing and item provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT course on heat transfer, diffusion, fluid flow and industrial-scale processing of metals, polymers, ceramics and electronic materials; includes assignments and exams.

resources.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
resources.access_policy: OpenCourseWare materials; retain MIT OCW licensing and item provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT course covering elastic/plastic deformation, creep and fracture with integrated laboratory experiments, assignments and exams.

resources.title: Electronic and Mechanical Properties of Materials
resources.access_policy: OpenCourseWare materials; retain MIT OCW licensing and item provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT graduate course covering electrical, optical, magnetic and mechanical properties across metals, semiconductors, ceramics and polymers, with problem sets and exams.

resources.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
resources.access_policy: OpenCourseWare materials; retain MIT OCW licensing and item provenance.
resources.provenance: Official MIT graduate course extending deformation, creep, fracture and fatigue into research-linked special topics, with projects, problem sets and exams.

resources.title: NIST Materials
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.access_policy: Public web resources; verify rights and terms for each linked dataset or publication before local ingestion.

resources.title: Materials Genome Initiative at NIST
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.access_policy: Metadata, tools, reports, and linked resources are public; preserve item-level licensing and provenance.
resources.provenance: Official NIST Materials Genome Initiative program.

resources.title: NIST Materials Data Repository
resources.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.access_policy: Public repository discovery; usage terms can be defined by individual data providers and must be retained per record.

resources.title: NASA Technical Standards - Materials and Processes, Parts
resources.access_policy: Use standards metadata and official public documents according to their stated distribution and rights; do not assume third-party endorsed standards are freely reproducible.
resources.provenance: Official NASA Technical Standards System, technical discipline 6000.

intentional_gaps: dedicated composites curriculum remains thinner than core structure/processing coverage
specialized biomaterials instruction remains thinner than general materials coverage
advanced hands-on characterization and computational-materials training require additional exact instructional sources
research portals and graduate courses do not by themselves establish expert readiness
expert readiness requires runtime retrieval, practical projects, verification/validation and passed assessment
coverage_notes.policy: Coverage is conservative. Assessed courses support instructional cells; portals, repositories and standards catalogs are retained as research/reference evidence and are not treated as blanket learner-competence or ingestion evidence.
